From: Kari Thompson <kari@healthbridge.io>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Jul 2028 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Private deployment demo for HealthBridge (HIPAA workload)

Hi Naomi —

We just completed the self-serve signup and selected the ‘Private (VPC/on-prem)’ interest option for a pilot. HealthBridge is preparing to evaluate vendors for a regulated workload (PHI scope). Can we schedule a 45 minute demo next week focused on:
- architecture for tenant isolation and network requirements
- SOC 2 / encryption & KMS integrations
- proof-of-concept timeline and required evidence

Attendees: me (Security PM) and John Lee (Infra Eng). Timezone: PST (we're based in San Francisco).

Ideal windows: Tue/Wed afternoon (PST) but we can be flexible. Thanks — excited to learn more.

Kari Thompson
Security Program Manager | HealthBridge
kari@healthbridge.io
+1 415-555-0198

Attachment: none
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>

Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Jul 2028 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Private deployment demo for HealthBridge (HIPAA workload)

Hi Kari — great to see the signup, and welcome.

We can absolutely tailor the session to tenant isolation, network controls, and the evidence you need for a POC. A couple quick asks so we bring the right docs and folks:
- Can you confirm whether you need a recorded session uploaded to your procurement portal?
- Do you need a red-team / pen test summary as part of the evidence bundle?
- Any specific compliance controls (e.g., HSM/EKM requirements) we should prepare for?

Proposed 45-min slots (PST):
- Tue Jul 11, 2:30pm–3:15pm
- Tue Jul 11, 4:00pm–4:45pm
- Wed Jul 12, 1:00pm–1:45pm

I’m cc'ing Vivek (solutions engineer) and Grace (SDR ops) so we can include a calendar invite and the SOC 2 summary + network diagram in advance. Once you confirm a slot we'll send an invite and a short evidence packet.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Enterprise SDR | Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com

Hi Naomi — thanks for the quick reply and for looping people in.

We can do Tue Jul 11 but need to shift to 4:00pm–4:45pm PST if that still works (John has a morning release window earlier in the day).

Evidence checklist we expect before the call:
- SOC 2 Type II summary (high level)
- network diagram showing VPC peering and allowed ingress/egress points
- encryption at rest + KMS/HSM details (are we able to use our key manager? EKM?)

Also — we typically require a brief statement about data residency for the POC (where logs/metrics live) and an ops contact for onboarding.

If you can send the two docs in advance, that will help speed up procurement.

Thanks — see you Tue 4pm PST.

Thanks Kari — Tue Jul 11 at 4:00pm PST is locked in from our side. Calendar invite attached (redwood-demo-calendar.ics).

I've attached a short SOC 2 summary and a draft VPC deployment diagram in case John wants to review prior to the demo. Quick notes:
- SOC2-summary.pdf: high-level scope and contact for compliance questions. Not a substitute for your procurement bundle, but should cover the initial ask.
- deployment-diagram-vpc.png: example of a private VPC layout with optional peering and private endpoints. We can adapt this during the demo.

On EKM: we support bring-your-own-key via KMS integrations for Dedicated/Dedicated+Private flows. For on-prem customers we can discuss connector options with your infra team; Vivek will cover specifics during the demo.

Data residency: metrics/logs for Private deployments can be routed to your VPC or to an isolated account depending on the package — we will highlight options in the demo.

HubSpot: I've linked the record here for your reference: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/67890

If you'd like the session recorded for procurement, please reply and we will record and provide a secure link.

See you Tue 4:00pm PST — invite attached.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Enterprise SDR | Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com
